Data extraction: PO gettext message pairs with msgid as key and msgstr as value

```swift title="Swift"

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"po\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "msgid \"Hello\"\nmsgstr \"Hallo\"\n", config: configObj)
```
